description: React component for displaying and managing attachment files, including viewing, downloading, and deleting attachments with modal preview.

methods.name: onModalClose
methods.description: Closes the modal dialog by setting modalVisible to false.

methods.name: onViewClick
methods.description: Handles viewing an attachment, displaying image or text in modal.

methods.name: onDownloadClick
methods.description: Handles downloading an attachment by creating a temporary URL.

methods.name: onDeleteAttachmentClick
methods.description: Triggers deletion of an attachment via mutation.

methods.name: safeResolveMime
methods.description: Resolves MIME type to a human-readable name, with error handling.
